text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's the day after the Tracen Meet.
For the
first time ever, Vodka
doesn't show up for
training.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Oh hey, you're Vodka's trainer, right?
Don't tell me... has she not
shown up?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, she's probably at the riverbank. Ever
since she read this one
manga, she's all, "if
I'm gonna be brooding, it has to be by a 
riverbank."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
She always talks about how cool it is...
Heh, what a dummy.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I might have my complaints about her, but
I'm not my best self when
she's not
around... So please, bring her back.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After thanking Daiwa Scarlet, I hurry to
the riverbank.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Oh... 'Sup, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, I know that already. I'm skipping
today—no buts!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ughhh, shut up already! Get lost—just
leave me alone!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Leave someone as... lame as me alone!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I thought I had it in me.
I was really goin'
all out—I was gonna be the
rising star that
took down Narita Brian!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
But... when we started actually running, I
could feel the huge gap
between us. I felt
like I was gonna pass out halfway through!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I thought to myself, "I can't do it."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
But those racers I grew up watching... the
ones in the Derby—not a
single one of
them ever gave up!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Trainer... am I just no good?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
If this is how I am pre-debut, then how am
I ever gonna be cool?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's obvious that Vodka is losing her
confidence. How can I cheer her
up?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I might have my complaints about her, but
I'm not my best self when
she's not
around... So please, bring her back.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, why did Daiwa Scarlet
say that to me? Maybe she
wanted to tell
Vodka something...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Huh? No, like I said—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hey! Stop pushin' me! What're you doin'?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Huff... Ah, it's Vodka.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...Scarlet.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Why are you here? You told me you
wanted to take a break after the
Meet.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. I changed my schedule. You have a
problem with that?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
It's all because some dummy decided to go
up against the big leagues... Yet despite
her opponent's breakneck pace, she kept
up
just fine.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
And she even accelerated during the
straightaways... Made me think,
"I can't let
myself be left behind."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Scarlet, you...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, I need to get back to training
now.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
The hell is she talkin' about?
Lookin' up to
me like that... Meanwhile,
I... I'm here
being super lame!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Yeah... but I gave up in the middle!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: The future?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Up... to me... I... I...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Trainer! I got a favor to ask!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Please... help me redeem myself!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Since then, Vodka has had a resurgence of
focus and motivation.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: There you are, Scarlet! C'mon, let's race!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Huh? I can't, I already have plans—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Don't sweat the small stuff! C'mon,
it's just
one lap! You ready? Here
we go!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Wait! Get back here!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Several days later...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Lookin' forward to it, Brian!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. Bring it on.
I'll make you regret it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Vodka has decided to challenge Narita
Brian to a one-on-one
rematch!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hmph!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Uuurgh!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
(Holy craaaap! She's fast! How the hell am
I supposed to catch up?)

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: (But I...)

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Arghhh!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: (I won't give up! Not ever again!)

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: (I'll do whatever it takes to be cool!)

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Yaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In the end, Narita Brian wins the race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite the overwhelming difference in
skill, Vodka musters every
ounce of her
strength to chase after the formidable
"beast."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Not bad. Let's do this again.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Oh! Th-thank you so much, Brian!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Trainer... Hehe, thank you!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna be even cooler from now on, so
watch carefully—'cause ya
won't wanna
miss it!
